method: dataprep/room_gt.py: laser stations inside the captured room, sharpest-histogram yaw, floor/ceiling = strongest horizontal planes, each main wall = strongest range^2-weighted plane in a manually chosen window (W:-0.92:-0.84,E:2.35:2.43,S:-3.05:-2.97,N:0.73:0.81)
note: Opening to an adjacent space on the east side (main face 53 % of the side); cabinets in front of the north wall are furniture.
openings_method: dataprep/openings_gt.py: openings marked roughly on laser elevation images by a person, edges snapped to the laser wall (50 % solid-share crossing, 1 cm columns)
